SIMPLE ENGLISH
Session fixation occurs when a known session identifier persists after authentication; rotate
identifiers at trust changes.
සිංහJලෙන් Login කලින් තිJයන session ID එක login පසුවතේ එකම නම් අවදානමකේ. Successful login පසු
An anonymous cart session becomes an authenticated session with a new ID.

VISUAL MODEL · 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · Anonymous SID A · Login verified · Rotate to SID B · Invalidate SID A · Follow the controls from left to right · Read the diagram: Anonymous SID A → Login verified → Rotate to SID B → Invalidate SID A. Login කලින් තිJයන · session ID එක login පසුවතේ එකම නම් අවදානමකේ. Successful login පසු session ID එක regenerate කරන්න.
Expected result: Previous identifier no longer authenticates the logged-in user.
When rotate session IDs? At login and significant privilege changes.

PRACTICE
Test that the pre-login session ID no longer grants
access.
